purpose: offline lens-model feasibility; no production activation
validation_protocol: Hold out entire view from intrinsics/lens fit; estimate its pose on checkerboard parity 0, score parity 1; swap and concatenate.
validation_limit: Other corners of the held-out image fit pose, so this tests projection consistency with unseen poses, not independently measured table XY or ball centers. Neighboring corner errors may be correlated.
limitations: Assembled 20 × 14 inch target scale and flat rigid backing remain unverified; nominal pitch is used for exploratory fitting only.
Parity-held-out corners still share a board pose and correlated detection/print/assembly errors. Pixel reprojection consistency is not physical table XY accuracy.

The 10 × 7 square pattern has no asymmetric orientation marker. Detector row/column axes can reverse between views; central column is symmetric, possible horizontal seam rows are 2 or 3 in internal-corner coordinates.
Residual grouping can expose patterns, but cannot distinguish lens errors, board warping, local corner bias, or assembly errors independently.
Uniform pitch scale changes pose translation without identifying true table scale. Nonuniform printing/assembly or nonplanarity can bias intrinsics.
Earlier small-board and new large-board errors are normalized by image width only; they are different targets, poses, corner precision and images, not matched physical placements.
No camera, production calibration, ball estimator, or configuration is modified. No fisheye model is fitted.

cross_target_frozen_models.assumption: Approximate unchanged camera framing with direct image-width scaling; verify against the separate static rail registration audit. Registration residuals limit subpixel cross-target interpretation.
cross_target_frozen_models.baseline_training_note: Old-frozen-zero trained on old small-board views001–008; only old view009 is prospective for that baseline. New fits train on no old small-board images. No new physical observations are collected.
